---
title: "Download MSMS"
---

The current release is **MSMS 2.6.2** (November 2026). It fixes crashes on large or unusual
inputs, merges duplicate atoms instead of stopping, and runs `-all_components` in parallel. For
inputs that 2.6.1 handled, the output is unchanged. See the [release notes](release-notes.qmd).

MSMS is free for non-commercial use; commercial use needs a license (see [License](license.qmd)).

| Platform | Version | File | Unpack with |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linux 64-bit | 2.6.2 | [Linux 64-bit tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.2/msms_i86_64Linux2_2.6.2.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_i86_64Linux2_2.6.2.tar.gz` |
| macOS before 10.14 (pre-Mojave) | 2.6.1 | [macOS tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_MacOSX_2.6.1.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_MacOSX_2.6.1.tar.gz` |
| macOS 10.14 (Mojave) and later, Intel | 2.6.1 | [macOS tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_x86_64Darwin_2.6.1.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_x86_64Darwin_2.6.1.tar.gz` |
| macOS, Apple silicon (Arm64) | 2.6.1 | [Arm64 tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_Arm64_2.6.1.tgz) | `tar zxvf msms_Arm64_2.6.1.tgz` |
| Windows | 2.6.1 | [Windows zip file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_win32_2.6.1.zip) | extract the files from `msms_win32_2.6.1.zip` |

::: {.callout-note}
Version 2.6.2 is available for Linux only so far. The macOS and Windows downloads are still
version 2.6.1, without the 2.6.2 fixes.
:::

The Linux tar file contains two binaries. `msms.x86_64Linux2.2.6.2.staticgcc` runs on any 64-bit
x86 Linux; `msms.x86_64Linux2.2.6.2` needs glibc 2.34 or later, libtirpc and libgomp.

The files are on GitHub, in the
[msms-2.6.2](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/tag/msms-2.6.2) and
[msms-2.6.1](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/tag/msms-2.6.1) releases. The 2.6.1
release also has the previous Linux version. See the [Documentation](documentation.qmd) for how
to run `msms`.
